map.再取前 10 位按权重 11…2 重算第 2 位校验位: Then take the first 10 digits and recompute the second check digit with weights 11...2
map.前 9 位按权重 10..2 加权求和，(和×10) mod 11 得第 1 位: Weight the first 9 digits by 10..2 and sum them; (sum x 10) mod 11 gives the first check digit; then recompute the second check digit from the 10 digits with weights 11..2, recording a remainder of 10 as 0.
